hiw.title: How LiveGuard works
hiw.continuousTitle: Why continuous protection, not just at login?
hiw.continuousText: Most fraud doesn't happen at the front door. A password protects the moment you sign in. But what happens after? A phone left unattended, a session left open, a SIM card hijacked mid-transaction — these are the moments fraudsters exploit, not the login itself. LiveGuard keeps watching after you sign in, exactly when it matters most: during the action itself. If something seems unusual — you left the app a moment too long, for example — a simple check is enough to confirm it's still you, before continuing.
hiw.learningTitle: A system that learns, not a fixed secret
hiw.learningText: We don't claim to have an impossible-to-fool system. We have a system that improves. Every real verification, performed by a real person, strengthens our ability to tell authentic human behavior apart from an imitation attempt. It's not a fixed formula we hope stays uncrackable forever — it's a living model that gets better with every use. The more LiveGuard is used, the more precise it becomes. It's protection that ages well.
hiw.whyTitle: Why playful exercises instead of a photo or your voice?
hiw.whyText: A face or a voice can be stolen — a photo, a recording, a deepfake. The way you react, tap, and remember is far harder to imitate. And most importantly: it avoids collecting sensitive biometric data nobody wants to give away.
hiw.badDayTitle: What if I'm having a bad day, or a new phone?
hiw.badDayText: No worries. The system adapts to you — this isn't a test to pass or fail. It gently learns how you interact, without ever blocking you for a bad day.
hiw.privacyText: LiveGuard only collects timing and movement patterns. Never the content.
